dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: What? You seriously broke the Seven-Star Array? Ugh, looks like I'll have to write this into the weekly report...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Make sure you make it sound cool, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *cough* Please, this is a very serious situation. It's so serious, in fact, that the Qixing themselves will decide its exact seriousness.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Which is to say that once report gets sent up, someone from the Qixing might personally come down here to stop you.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Even I won't be able to save you then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This guy is way too obvious with his hints...)

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Scared, huh? Alright, move along, then! There's still someone waiting for you, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: How is everything down there? Did you encounter any danger?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Ah, I see. That does sound rather dangerous. I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to help take care of Jinwu and Zhiqiong, then.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Aren't you supposed to stop me?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Well, that is my duty, yes. But you always run off too quickly for me to stop you, so I can't.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: No, you do. That's what the report says, and what the report says is the truth.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, guess I'm really, really fast, then.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Exactly. As such, please do be careful.

choices.text: All goes well, don't you fret.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: That's good, that's good. As long as things go well, the Qixing will have no reason to come down too hard on me...
